Name: Make a Wish
Author: Willcraftapple11
Description:
Requirements: You need to have seen Maru's 6 heart event, and reached 7 hearts with her. She will send you a letter in the mail inviting you over to watch a meteor shower. This happens in the Mountains, after 10pm, on Sunny days.

The Wishes: 
[spoiler]You can wish for money, and get some cash. 
You can wish to be fast, and get a pile of espresso. 
Or you can wish to become green (recommend: wear a dyeable shirt!).[/spoiler]
Thanks to ANDYLAND for making a really fun game!
